name: Short link, co-rotating — upper link drives
note: Both short links turn the same way through travel, as on Giant’s Maestro and DW-link bikes. The lower link (MP to FP) pivots on the frame just behind the seat tube and reaches the rear triangle; the upper link (SP to LP) pivots on a bracket on the front of the seat tube and reaches the rear triangle ahead of it. The shock eye sits on the upper link and the shock runs forward and down to a mount on the down tube.
draft: rear triangle (FP-LP) crosses the seat tube; upper link rotates 59.7deg
